Great Starting Point

Basic

Essential Virtual Assistant Support

$5/ hour

For simple, clearly defined administrative tasks and everyday organization.

✓ What's Included

  • Email Organization: about 10–15 simple emails sorted into folders or labels.
  • Data Entry: about 20–30 clean, straightforward rows entered.
  • Excel & Google Sheets: basic updates, formatting, and simple data organization.
  • Web Research: about 3–5 basic records, with source links when available.
  • Social Scheduling: about 1–2 ready-to-publish posts scheduled using supplied content.

× Not Included

  • Email reply writing or professional business emails.
  • Customer support or complaint handling.
  • Lead qualification or detailed prospect research.
  • Custom Canva design, advanced formulas, dashboards, or automation.

Hourly estimate: Quantities vary with data quality and task complexity. Choose one main task or an agreed mix of smaller tasks per hour.

Most Popular

Standard

Professional Business Support

$15/ hour

For regular business administration, customer communication, and research support.

✓ What's Included

  • Email Management: organize about 10–15 simple emails, or draft around 4–6 short replies.
  • Data Entry: about 25–40 clean, straightforward rows entered.
  • Spreadsheets: sorting, filtering, formatting, and basic formulas.
  • Web Research & Leads: about 5–8 basic business records, with source links when available.
  • Customer Support: draft about 4–6 routine replies using your approved FAQ and policies.
  • Professional English: short business email drafts, proofreading, and tone improvement.
  • Canva / Social Media: one simple template-based graphic or about 2–3 supplied posts scheduled per hour, depending on the task chosen.

× Not Included

  • Advanced dashboards, complex spreadsheet automation, or custom software.
  • Large batches of bespoke graphics or full branding projects.
  • Refunds, account changes, or business decisions without your approval.
  • Unlimited email, lead, design, or customer requests.

Hourly estimate: Listed quantities are task-specific estimates, not combined quotas. Time depends on the materials supplied and the complexity of each request.

Advanced Support

Premium

Complete Virtual Assistant Support

$20/ hour

For more detailed research, careful data handling, and a broader mix of business tasks.

✓ What's Included

  • Email Management: organize about 12–20 simple emails, or draft around 5–8 personalized short replies.
  • Data Entry: about 40–60 clean, straightforward rows entered.
  • Spreadsheets: data cleaning, consistency checks, suitable formulas, and detailed formatting.
  • Web Research & Leads: about 8–12 relevant business records researched and organized, with sources when available.
  • Customer Support: draft about 5–8 routine replies based on approved FAQs and policies.
  • Professional Writing: personalized business email drafts, proofreading, and tone refinement.
  • Canva / Social Media: about 1–2 simple template-based graphics or 4–5 supplied posts scheduled per hour, depending on the task chosen.

× Not Included

  • Complex software development or advanced automation projects.
  • Custom dashboard development beyond the agreed scope.
  • Unlimited live chat, phone support, or guaranteed response coverage.
  • Sending messages, making purchases, or changing account settings without authorization.

Hourly estimate: Detailed research and complex tasks may take longer. Final scope and priorities are agreed before work begins.

All prices are hourly. Task quantities are estimates for a single task or an agreed combination of small tasks—not a promise to complete every listed item in one hour. Additional time or work outside the agreed scope must be approved first.

I understand that running a business requires considerable effort, time, and planning. That is why my goal is to lighten your workload, simplify your day-to-day operations, and help create more time and opportunities for you to focus on growing your business.
